text: Santiago, Chile, 2008. A highway camera filmed a dog lying in the fast lane, *hit by a car.* Then a second dog ran out into the traffic. Cars flew past. The dog grabbed the injured one and *dragged it across the lanes* to the side of the road. Highway workers arrived, but the rescuer ran off. People offered to adopt the hero. *No one ever found it.* Send this to a true friend.
